articles.summary: The new Email API lets you check eligibility, provision a GoDaddy Business Email mailbox, and track it to completion from the gddy CLI or REST. Provisioning also configures MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC automatically, and the Shopping API can buy a plan first.
